title: Standard ACLs: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Picture a bouncer at a club door. This one checks only one thing. Where you came from.

scenes.heading: The guest list
scenes.narration: The bouncer holds a clipboard, and that's the access list. Each line says allow or deny. Every person is checked from the top, and the first match wins. If you're not on the list at all, you're turned away. That's the implicit deny at the end. A standard list checks only the source address.

scenes.heading: Writing one
scenes.narration: Here's a named standard list. Permit one network. Then apply it to an interface, with a direction. Standard lists go close to the destination.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three slip-ups. Standard lists cannot look at destinations or ports. A wildcard of all zeros matches one exact host, not everything. And lists don't work until you apply them with a direction.

items.right: Apply them yourself; pick in or out
